cli.intro: muse — audiovisual composition language and toolchain
cli.cmd.init: Create a Muse project with a starter script
cli.cmd.check: Parse and validate a Muse source file
cli.cmd.compile: Compile a Muse source and print its render plan
cli.cmd.render: Render a score or audiovisual output
cli.cmd.export: Export a composed score to a portable format
cli.cmd.asset.import: Copy a local file into the project asset directory
cli.cmd.asset.info: Print detected metadata for an asset file
cli.cmd.mcp.serve: Start the MCP server over stdio
cli.cmd.doctor: Check CLI install and native muse binary
cli.opt.emit: Render plan emission format (json or schema)
cli.opt.export-format: Export format (midi, musicxml, pdf, svg, or html)
cli.opt.max-duration: Cap MP4 encode to the first N wall-clock seconds (audio matches)
cli.opt.max-frames: Cap preview to the first N wall-clock frames (default 240)
cli.opt.entry: Entry id within a multi-entry project
cli.opt.job: ReleaseJob id from muse.von (resolves entry + context.locale; not with --entry)
